category: Russian multi-host link straightener (dead, domain repurposed)

free_tier.stated: Was a paid multi-host straightener for letitbit, depositfiles, turbobit and similar hosts; today the domain serves unrelated content and the live origin does not answer.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the service is gone

interface_detail: None. The 2023-02-05 capture of the domain is a Chinese-language gambling page wrapped around copied Ripple marketing text - the signature of an expired domain that was re-registered.
chaining: Nothing to chain; it is the archetype of the Russian link-straightener that died and whose domain was sold.

limits.value: the domain no longer belongs to the service; the live origin answers HTTP 530 on two attempts

limits_note: A 2011 blog post still describes it as 'takelink.org ... Скачать бесплатно прямые ссылки на файлообменники', and a 2012 forum post names it among services with Russian support; both predate the death.
binding_note: Nothing is served; the domain reassignment is the finding.

identity_cost.detail: not applicable: no account can be created

reliability_note: A dead multi-hoster's domain is a phishing surface: the brand still appears in old forum and blog recommendations, and the domain now serves unrelated content.
confidence_note: Two independent observations: the live origin returns HTTP 530 (twice, 2026-10-23), and the Wayback capture of 2023-02-05 is a repurposed gambling page. The service's own last state was not archived in a form that renders. Evidence dates normalised to the read date on 2026-10-23; a source that carries its own date keeps it in the proved field.

evidence.proved: the domain served a Chinese gambling page with copied Ripple copy ('澳洲幸运5开奖查询 ... Ripple is the leading provider of crypto solutions for businesses') - not the multi-hoster
HTTP 530 from the origin on two separate attempts; no content, no redirect to a successor
what the service was: 'takelink.org. Скачать бесплатно прямые ссылки на файлообменники'

notes: Named brief as a service Russian forums mention, so it is closed with evidence rather than left as an open question. The 2023 capture predates the check by three and a half years, which means the domain had already changed hands well before the live probe failed.
